query:
with target_store as (
  select id, store_no from public.stores
  where store_no = 3 and id = '6b2e76fd-b8f8-4fa9-b784-faee8eb4af36'::uuid
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'databaseRole', current_user,
  'transactionReadOnly', current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
  'authUsers', (select count(*) from auth.users),
  'emailConfirmedUsers', (select count(*) from auth.users where email_confirmed_at is not null),
  'emailUnconfirmedUsers', (select count(*) from auth.users where email_confirmed_at is null),
  'stores', (select count(*) from public.stores),
  'employees', (select count(*) from public.employees),
  'targetStore', (select jsonb_build_object(
    'storeNo', s.store_no,
    'storeId', s.id,
    'owners', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ownerId', e.id, 'isActive', e.is_active, 'pinChangeRequired', e.pin_change_required, 'permissionRevision', e.permission_revision) order by e.id), '[]'::jsonb) from public.employees e where e.store_id = s.id and e.role = 'owner'),
    'employeeSessions', (select jsonb_build_object(
      'total', count(*),
      'active', count(*) filter (where x.revoked_at is null and x.expires_at > statement_timestamp()),
      'revoked', count(*) filter (where x.revoked_at is not null)
    ) from private.employee_sessions x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'authSessionsSelectAllowed', has_table_privilege(current_user, 'auth.sessions', 'SELECT'),
    'authSessionRows', (select count(*) from auth.sessions a where a.user_id = s.id),
    'storeSettings', (select count(*) from public.store_settings x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'seedWorkflow', (select jsonb_build_object('requested', w.requested, 'status', w.status) from private.initial_seed_workflows w where w.store_id = s.id),
    'seedStages', (select count(*) from private.initial_seed_stages st join private.initial_seed_workflows w on w.workflow_id = st.workflow_id where w.store_id = s.id),
    'categories', (select count(*) from public.categories x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'menuItems', (select count(*) from public.menu_items x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'floorAreas', (select count(*) from public.floor_areas x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'tables', (select count(*) from public.tables x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'orders', (select count(*) from public.orders x where x.store_id = s.id),
    'payments', (select count(*) from public.payments x where x.store_id = s.id)
  ) from target_store s)
) as observation;
limitations: One-statement projection of target storeNo3 only; no individual employee/session rows from earlier TEST stores were returned.
Active employee session count uses revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > statement_timestamp().
auth.sessions was included under the prior optional source-verified scope; its count is not proof that already-issued JWT access tokens are invalidated.
The parent later clarified that auth.sessions was unnecessary; the query had already completed and no additional query or upstream investigation was performed afterward.
No app, Auth configuration, tenant or business data was modified by this inventory.
